chain.title: Tea, Growing Untended
chain.desc: Wild tea bushes generate in the world. Farmer's Respite follows Farmer's Delight's wild-patch pattern exactly, and this is where the whole mod starts.

chain.title: Taking A Cutting
chain.desc: Seeds from a wild bush. Tea bushes oxidise as they age, so planting them starts a clock you have to read.

chain.title: Picked Young
chain.desc: Harvest a tea bush early and the leaves are green. Timing the harvest is the mod's one real mechanic.

chain.title: The Second Cooking Block
chain.desc: The Kettle is to drinks what Farmer's Delight's Cooking Pot is to stews. Every tea, coffee and cider in the mod is poured out of it into a glass bottle.

chain.title: The First Brew
chain.desc: Kettle-poured from green leaves. Green tea gives a mining-speed effect, which is what makes this mod worth installing rather than merely pleasant.

chain.title: Left A Little Longer
chain.desc: Let a bush oxidise one stage past green. Same plant, different harvest window, different drink.

chain.title: Fully Oxidised
chain.desc: The last harvest stage. Black leaves are the strongest and the slowest to come round.

chain.title: An Invasive Crop
chain.desc: Coffee does not grow well in the Overworld. Plant it next to other crops and it feeds on them to grow - the mod's own advancement says so outright.

chain.title: Picking The Cherries
chain.desc: Harvested off a coffee bush. Knife them on a cutting board and they give the beans back.

chain.title: Left On The Heat
chain.desc: Every drink in this mod has three strengths - normal, long and strong - decided by how long the Kettle brews and how much you load in.

chain.title: Baked With Beans
chain.desc: Coffee beans, milk, egg, sugar and wheat. It cuts into slices and takes candles, like a vanilla cake.

chain.title: Fruit Off The Rose
chain.desc: Rose hips are the mod's foraged ingredient rather than a planted one, and they carry the pie and the tea that need no bush at all.

chain.title: Pie From The Hedgerow
chain.desc: The rose hip line's bake, and one of only two pies in the mod.

chain.title: Matcha, Baked
chain.desc: Green tea leaves folded into wheat. It is the only baked good the tea line produces on its own.

chain.title: Cooked With Leaves
chain.desc: Tea used as a savoury ingredient rather than a drink. The mod's most surprising recipe.

chain.title: Cured In Black Tea
chain.desc: Cooked cod, black tea leaves, cooked rice and cabbage. It needs the full oxidation ladder plus a Farmer's Delight rice paddy.

chain.title: Chili With Coffee In It
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: coffee beans, raw beef, blaze powder and nether wart. A Nether trip for a bowl of chili.

chain.title: Proved On Nether Wart
chain.desc: Sourdough started with nether wart instead of yeast. The strangest bread in the ecosystem.

notes: 48 ids come from the plain model-and-lang intersection; two more - farmersrespite:coffee_beans and farmersrespite:tea_seeds - are the crop seed items and needed extra proof, because their display names come from the BLOCK lang keys (block.farmersrespite.coffee_bush = 'Coffee Beans', block.farmersrespite.small_tea_bush = 'Tea Seeds') rather than item keys. They were confirmed three ways: an item model, a namespaced reference inside data/farmersrespite/*.json, and a class-constant match. Both are real ids and are the only way to plant either crop. The mod's defining mechanic, read straight from its own advancement descriptions in the lang file: tea bushes OXIDISE as they age, so green, yellow and black tea leaves are three harvest windows on the same plant rather than three plants - which is why the chain climbs green -> yellow -> black. Stunting a bush with an axe freezes it for decoration. Coffee is described as invasive and must be planted beside other crops to feed on them. Every drink exists in three strengths: base, long_* and strong_*, all produced by farmersrespite:kettle_pouring into a glass bottle, which is why the strength variants form their own wheel rather than cluttering the spine. The Kettle also re-pours three vanilla Farmer's Delight drinks (apple_cider, hot_cocoa, melon_juice) at strong and long strengths. The 30 lang-only entries are candle-cake and potted-bush block states and crop growth stages, correctly excluded. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooked_rice, farmersdelight:cabbage, farmersdelight:apple_cider / hot_cocoa / melon_juice, any forge:tools/knives knife.
